description: This file defines a controller class Order for the OpenCart admin dashboard extension, handling order-related dashboard functionalities such as displaying order stats, saving settings, and rendering views.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class managing the dashboard order widget, including displaying order stats, saving configuration, and rendering dashboard HTML.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes and displays the order dashboard widget with statistics and links.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of dashboard configuration settings via POST request.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Generates JSON data for the dashboard including total order count and percentage change, and renders the order info view.
